# once when

Run a block once when its condition first becomes true for the runtime instance.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `block.once_when` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Blocks |
| Family | DCode Conditional |
| Monaco kind | `block` |
| Format | `once when <condition>:` |
| Valid contexts | `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `once when condition:<br>    -- one-time work<br>` |

## Example

```lua
once when condition:
    -- one-time work
```
